name: Single-disc
blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.11: picks up the CSR v0.14.2 disc3.layer.json update that moves (not deletes) the PlayMovie opcodes in the ending fields LAS4_2/LAS4_3/LAS4_4/LASTMAP (fields 765-768), fixing a Disc 3 ending-sequence crash caused by those opcodes trying to play movie files absent from the Disc 1 single-disc LBA map. Retains the v0.2.10 break-scene (LOST2) and v0.2.8/v0.2.9 D1->D2 transition (BLACKBGB) fixes. Manip movies and endings are disabled pending re-validation on this new base.
hint: CSR. Fields-only core; movies/endings not yet re-enabled.
betaNote: v0.2.11: single-disc's safe-field merge pulls FIELD/LAS4_2.DAT, LAS4_3.DAT, LAS4_4.DAT, and LASTMAP.DAT wholesale from CSR Disc 3 (they're D3-only edits vs pristine on D1/D2), so the CSR v0.14.2 disc3.layer.json opcode-relocation fix (commit 9ad13bb) flows through automatically. Rebuilt in one pass via build_work_bin.py (all field merges + verified BLACKBGB manual splice + SNOVA inject + FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN table fix) and re-diffed against the CSR v0.14.2 D1 base. Not yet playtested past the Disc 3 ending sequence on DuckStation -- please playtest a full run through the ending. Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
